description: This file defines a singleton class BooleanValueValidator, which validates if a given CharSequence represents a boolean value ('true' or 'false'). It extends an abstract validator and throws an exception if validation fails.

classes.name: BooleanValueValidator
classes.description: A singleton validator class that checks if a CharSequence can be parsed as a boolean value ('true' or 'false'). It extends AbstractHeaderValueValidator and is immutable.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of BooleanValueValidator.

methods.name: validateValue
methods.description: Validates that the provided CharSequence value equals 'true' or 'false' as strings; throws exception if not.
